page.overview:
Who is Iceberg?

Getting Iceberg to volunteer for an Arctic mission is never a problem. Being in places with cold weather is what he strives for. Cold desolate places may make others want to surrender but for him, it brings out the will to survive. While others tolerate the cold to the best of their ability, Iceberg immerses himself in his environment. If Dusty is Joes' answer to the desert environment then Iceberg is to the cold. Those two share a similar mindset in surviving the most unforgiving places on Earth.

Iceberg and Frostbite were stationed at the Apogee Base in Greenland when it was attacked by Destro and a squad of F.A.N.G.s. The attack was fought off and Iceberg and Flint pursued Destro. When their Snow Cat was overcome by a blizzard, Iceberg returned to base whilst Flint continued on foot.

Iceberg was one of the Joes that was protecting the DNA of Ivan the Terrible from Cobra. He was turned into an Orca in the episode "Iceberg Goes South". Iceberg's nightmare in the Episode "Nightmare Assualt" was that he was in The Arctic and was attacked by giant cobras.
